sourceTitle: History of the Conflict Between Religion and Science
description: "History of the Conflict Between Religion and Science" by John William Draper is a historical account written in the late 19th century. The work explores the ongoing struggle between religious beliefs and scientific thought throughout history, tracing the roots of this conflict back to ancient civilizations and the rise of modern science.
